messages:
marta: Kickoff — we need a concise PRD for a graceful degradation playbook that covers tiered routing, region-aware fallbacks, and model-variant compatibility. Customer asks are piling up. I'd like to scope an MVP + launch criteria. Who can help outline acceptance criteria and edge cases? @samir @kevin

samir: I can lead acceptance criteria. Quick q: include quantized / FP16 variants in scope or treat as stretch?

marta: MVP: require support for 3 model variants per family (full, quantized, distilled). FP16 only for Dedicated or instances with explicit hardware support. Call out tokenizer / vocab mismatch as a hard incompatibility.

kevin: I'll draft routing matrix. Suggest we expose a compact DSL: `tier -> region -> fallback_chain`. Example config snippet:
```
routing_policy:
  tiers:
    gold:
      region_affinity: [us-west-2, us-east-1]
      fallback_chain: [dedicated-full, dedicated-quant, hosted-full]
    standard:
      region_affinity: [us-east-1]
      fallback_chain: [hosted-full, hosted-quant]
```
This covers ordering and region preference.

jordan: Console needs checkboxes and an override UI for per-route fallback. Also surface active fallback reason in traces (:eyes:).

sarah: Edge cases to list in PRD:
- tokenizer mismatch => fail fast + clear error to customer
- partial KV cache invalidation when switching variants => possible ~2x latency on first requests
- model family mismatch (e.g., gpt2 vs preference) => block
- cross-region privacy/regulatory constraints => no cross-region fallback unless allowed

ops-bot: automated note: canary window scheduled for next Wednesday 03:00 UTC. :information_source:

marta: Acceptance criteria (draft):
- functional: fallback order applied in 100% of simulated outage scenarios in staging
- performance: p99 latency on fallback <= 1.5x baseline for that route
- correctness: <0.1% customer-visible error rate attributable to routing/fallback in 30d during canary
- observability: fallback events emitted with route, reason, variant, and trace id
- safety: auto-rollback if eval harness detects quality regression > 3 BLEU/ROUGE equiv

samir: Tests to add in CI:
- compatibility matrix run across sample prompts for each model variant
- perf harness with KV/cache warm/cold scenarios
- chaos test: simulate regional outage and verify fallback chain
- regression test: eval-set scoring after fallback

kevin: Priority list for MVP:
1) policy DSL + parser + storage
2) compatibility table + validator
3) runtime: implement fallback chain resolution and metrics
4) canary rollout plumbing + automatic trace annotations
Stretch: per-tenant override, per-route quotas, advanced quality-based routing

jordan: Ownership: @samir drafts PRD, @marta reviews, @kevin writes arch section, @jordan + @sarah specify console and QA tests. Ops to confirm canary window.

marta: Timeline: draft PRD by Fri EOD, internal review next Tue, canary planned two weeks out. Please drop short bullets in this thread for anything missing. :thumbsup:

kevin: One more edge: when model shard placement differs (some models only on dedicated), ensure routing table flags 'capacity-limited' so we don't route customers into soft-fail loops.

sarah: I'll add sample prompts for compatibility tests and a short doc on tokenizer checks.

samir: I'll open a PR against `eng-platform/routing` repo with a skeleton PRD and the config parser spec.

marta: Awesome — thanks everyone. Let's keep comments short on the PRD PR. If blockers, ping me directly. :rocket:
